applied.quote: At the defaults, owning costs more each month from the start.
applied.replacement: At the defaults, owning costs more than renting in the first month.
applied.why: SOURCE gives only first-month costs, not every month.

applied.quote: The payment rises to $2,472.95 because it includes mortgage insurance, and the break-even moves to year 30.
applied.replacement: The payment is $2,472.95 with mortgage insurance included, and the break-even moves to year 30.
applied.why: SOURCE says the payment includes mortgage insurance, not that insurance causes the rise.

applied.quote: The payment rises to $2,472.95 because mortgage insurance is added.
applied.replacement: The payment is $2,472.95 with mortgage insurance included.
applied.why: SOURCE says the payment includes mortgage insurance, not that insurance causes the rise.

applied.quote: If you want to buy for space, stability or control of the property, the model does not price those reasons, so treat the net-worth gap it shows as what those benefits cost you.
applied.replacement: If you want to buy for space, stability or control of the property, the model does not price those reasons.
applied.why: SOURCE never equates the net-worth gap with the cost of those benefits
